reuse.why: Reuses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser and folds the five copied category queries into one helper, though copyPreviousMonth's existing getBudgetData filter is not reused or aligned.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the month-wide category query in favour of getMonthWideBudgetCategories; the separate exclusion logic in copyPreviousMonth stays as a second, now-diverging copy of the rule.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to its callers; the tag check is done in JS after a SQL join, which is reasonable given tags are parsed by a shared TS function.

scope.why: Core change is focused, but the test file carries unrelated import reordering and prettier reflows of existing tests.

maintainability.why: One named selection function for most month-wide actions is easy to own; the miss on copyPreviousMonth leaves one month-wide action outside the rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags instead of hand-parsing '#fixed'.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated queries were actually consolidated, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule lives in getMonthWideBudgetCategories used by setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg, but copyPreviousMonth still decides exclusions itself via getBudgetData + its own hidden/goal_def checks and does not apply the fixed-group rule.
